testPolicy.text: Submitting an SAT or ACT is optional and not required for admission. In addition to being test-optional, UChicago practices a 'No Harm' policy: any score submitted is only used in review if it will positively affect an applicant's chance of admission. Applies to all applicants, domestic, international and transfer.

cost.totalIncludes: on-campus budget: tuition 75,960 + Student Services Fee 1,677 + UPASS transit fee 318 + food and housing 21,414 + books and course materials 1,800 + personal 1,950 + travel allowance 702 = 103,821. Not included: health insurance (U-SHIP, required unless waived) and the Class Fee of 720 charged to students first enrolling in 2026 in each of their first two years.

aidPromise.text: UChicago guarantees free tuition to students who are the first in their families to attend college and to families with incomes under $250,000 per year (with typical assets). Families earning less than $125,000 per year (with typical assets) have tuition, fees, and standard room and meals covered by financial aid. UChicago meets 100% of demonstrated need with grants and no loan expectation, for domestic and international admitted students who applied for aid.

facts.text: UChicago offers four rounds: binding Early Decision I and non-binding, non-restrictive Early Action (both due November 2, 2026), and binding Early Decision II and Regular Decision (both due January 4, 2027).
Students can switch from Early Action to Early Decision I until December 1, and deferred Early Action or Regular Decision applicants can switch to Early Decision II until January 15.
Families earning under $125,000 with typical assets pay nothing for tuition, fees, housing and meals; families under $250,000, and all first-generation students, get free tuition.
Testing is optional with a 'No Harm' rule: a submitted SAT or ACT is only used if it helps the applicant; 57% of the fall 2025 entrants submitted the SAT (middle 50% 1500-1560) and 25% the ACT.
The 2026-27 on-campus cost of attendance is $103,821, of which tuition is $75,960; health insurance comes on top unless waived.
For fall 2025, 2,039 of 45,533 applicants were admitted and 1,786 enrolled, a yield of about 88%.

notes: CDS 2025-26 (file published August 2026) reports Fall 2025 data in C1 and 2026-2027 costs in G1, although its page headers still read 'Common Data Set 2024-2025' (template label). UChicago left blank in the CDS: C1 residency split, C2 waitlist counts, C21 ED application/admit counts, and C21/C22 dates. CDS G1 first-year required fees are 2,715 (includes the 720 Class Fee); the cost page lists 1,677 + 318 = 1,995 for all students, used here. No official Class of 2030 (fall 2026) figures found without web search (search budget exhausted); cycleNewer left null. Start date of the test-optional policy not on the pages opened, so 'since' is null. The admissions site is a Gatsby app: text was read from its page-data JSON for the same URLs.
